svg.title: mvdis-watch：36 個監理站 × 10 種照類的考照名額監測
svg.desc: A single Cloudflare Worker rescans 360 station/class combinations: the 108 popular ones about every 10 minutes, the 252 others about every 2 hours, and 153 combinations with no sessions once a day. It uses 14 of the 50 allowed subrequests per run on the free plan. It is not real-time because the source has no push.

g.text: ■ 釋出名額 □ 無場次（153 組），每日檢查
熱門約 10 分、冷門約 2 小時，速度按比例
每次執行 14／50 個子請求，免費方案
不是即時：官網沒有推播
